label: Generative Design
descZh: 以算法模型描述设计规则，研究复杂系统中的建筑形态生成、类型编码与方案优化，把设计问题转译为可计算、可迭代的形式探索。
descEn: Describing design rules as algorithmic models: form generation, typological encoding and optimisation in complex systems, turning design questions into computable, iterative explorations.

label: Fabrication
descZh: 打通参数模型、结构优化、构件编码、机器人或数控加工与现场建造的连续工作流，让算法生成的形态真正落地。
descEn: Connecting parametric models, structural optimisation, component encoding, robotic or CNC machining and on-site assembly into one continuous workflow, so that algorithmically generated form can be built.

label: Urban Computing
descZh: 面向城市形态的多源数据、特征提取与相似性检索，发展 ArchIndex、Archibase 等数据平台，为城市设计与历史地段研究提供量化依据。
descEn: Multi-source data, morphological feature extraction and similarity retrieval for urban form. Platforms such as ArchIndex and Archibase provide a quantitative basis for urban design and historic-area research.

titleZh: 计算性设计教学与工具
label: Pedagogy
descZh: 自 2006 年参与东南大学与 ETH CAAD 的生成设计合作教学；近年以 ArchiWeb 系列浏览器工具支持设计课程，让参数化生成与 AI 图像进入日常教学。
descEn: Involved in cooperative generative-design teaching between Southeast University and the ETH CAAD chair since 2006. More recently, the ArchiWeb browser tools bring parametric generation and AI imagery into the design studio.
